variant.briefing:
Hey,

We need someone to make a couple runs if you’re interested. Some important supplies need to be distributed across [Location]. Here are the details. 

Everything needs to be picked up from [Location] then distributed to the following spots: 

Package #[Item1] to [Destination].
Package #[Item4] to [Destination].
Package #[Item5] to [Destination1].
Package #[Item2] to [Destination1].
Package #[Item3] to [Destination2].

Shouldn’t be too difficult. Plus, it’ll give you the chance to familiarize yourself with the outpost and see all the good work the CFP is doing.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
